comment: alice challenges bob to reversi moving first, so she plays black; bob accepts, and black wipes white out in nine moves.
Cells are a column letter then a row number, sent as text; legal_cells is the viewer's own.
A cell that flips no disc is an illegal_action, and the game does not move on.

body.message: a1 flips no disc; a move must flip at least one

comment: Black's f4 turns white's last disc: neither seat can move, so the game ends on the count, more_discs.
A later read of the finished game carries the final view.
A second game reaches the shortest pass there is, eight plies in: after white's c1 black has no move.
White's c1 leaves black blocked: the update carries placed then passed {by: black}, and white is to act again.
White moves again; then black resigns.
